# Backtest results (generated by `python -m research.make_results`)

Live configuration: an equal-weight ensemble of 4 sleeves, top 25 coins by volume, 3 daily
tranches. Every fill pays the 0.1% taker fee. Binance hourly data. 2021-22 was never used
for design. Raw files: `daily_equity.csv`, `yearly.csv`, `windows_14d.csv`, `crash_events.csv`.

## Whole periods

| Period | Strategy | BTC | Equal-weight market |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021-02 → 2022-12 (unseen) | +19.8%, Sharpe 0.70, max DD 28.3% | -54.1%, Sharpe -0.22, max DD 77.2% | -12.5%, Sharpe 0.42, max DD 82.6% |
| 2023-01 → 2025-05 (in-sample) | +35.4%, Sharpe 0.96, max DD 16.9% | +532.8%, Sharpe 1.81, max DD 32.3% | +277.7%, Sharpe 1.15, max DD 63.6% |
| 2025-06 → 2026-10 (out-of-sample) | +41.2%, Sharpe 1.85, max DD 14.7% | -21.0%, Sharpe -0.21, max DD 53.7% | -15.2%, Sharpe 0.16, max DD 64.8% |
| Full 2021-02 → 2026-10 | +128.9%, Sharpe 1.08, max DD 28.3% | +129.2%, Sharpe 0.54, max DD 77.2% | +178.8%, Sharpe 0.63, max DD 82.6% |
